title: AI Cameras: What They Are and Why They Matter
summary: AI-powered home security isn't just a buzzword. Here's what an AI camera powered by Arlo Intelligence actually does.
body_markdown:
Artificial intelligence and machine learning are, essentially, robust pattern recognition tools. Feed AI a data set, ask it a question, and it’ll scour that data to look for the best possible answer. An AI camera uses these tools to enhance its recognition of people and objects that enter the frame, sending you an alert containing specific details of who or what is near your house.


Before AI, a smart security camera could recognize motion or sounds and send you a notification when an event was detected. However, pinpointing the specific source of an event trigger was much more difficult, since these cameras typically only detected changes in pixels or sound. With an AI camera, you can tag individuals, vehicles, or other details on your feed and the AI algorithm will create a data set that intelligently recognizes when they show up again at your house.


The possibilities are huge. Instead of wondering if your kids made it home safely from school, AI cameras like the[Arlo Pro 6th Gen](https://us.arlo.com/products/arlo-pro-6) can recognize when they arrive, giving you the information you need without scrubbing your feed to find out more. And by recognizing the regular family members and visitors in your life, AI cameras make it that much easier to pinpoint suspicious activity should it appear on your property.
